newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,196 to dollar for Sept 16 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,196 to dollar for Sept 16 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 3,196 to the dollar for September 16.
This reference rate was set on Thursday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Wednesday for September 13 to 15 is 3,177 to the dollar, the same rate as on Thursday.
